 Gold Price Trends in Kolkata During October
 If you track October closely, the Gold Price in Kolkata has stayed within a noticeable range rather than following a straight path. There have been periods where prices remained steady, followed by phases where they adjusted again.
The highest level for 24K gold reached ₹15,142, while the lowest was seen at ₹14,438. This spread helps in understanding how the Gold Rate in Kolkata behaves over shorter timeframes, where consistency is rare and variation is more common.
 What Affects Gold Price in Kolkata?
 The Gold Price today in Kolkata is shaped by a mix of factors, and they don’t act in isolation.
Global gold prices usually set the base direction, which then reflects across markets.
Currency exchange rates, especially USD to INR, influence how those global prices translate locally.
Demand in Kolkata changes depending on the season, and during peak periods, it tends to push pricing activity further.
Taxes like GST remain a constant part of the pricing structure and affect the final amount paid.
Because all of these keep changing in small ways, the Gold Rate in Kolkata continues to adjust regularly rather than staying fixed.

Why Gold Prices Don’t Stay Still 
The gold rate today in Kolkata tends to shift more frequently than many expect. A glance at the gold price in Kolkata at different times of the day can show small variations, which is a normal market pattern. These movements are often linked to global signals such as inflation data, interest rate changes, and currency fluctuations.
Alongside global factors, the gold rate in Kolkata is also influenced by domestic conditions. Festive and wedding-related demand, changes in import duty, and GST considerations all contribute to how the gold price today is reflected in the market.
 City-to-City Variations 
The gold price in Kolkata may not always match other cities exactly. Minor differences are common and are shaped by local demand, logistics expenses, and jeweller-level pricing decisions, even when the broader gold benchmark remains similar across regions.
 What Type of Gold Suits You? 
 24K Gold: High-purity gold closely linked with the gold price today in Kolkata .
 22K Gold: Commonly used in jewellery, balancing durability and value while tracking the gold rate .
 18K Gold: Preferred for modern jewellery designs, influenced by overall gold price trends.
